target_customer: Retail investors in Colombia and wider Latin America, many new to investing
problem: Colombian brokerages served high-net-worth clients and charged around 30 USD or more per trade; trii offers cheap, fast, regulated stock investing in an app.
business_model: Brokerage app earning commissions and fees through a licensed partner brokerage

founders.name: Carlos Guayara
education: Economist and business administrator, institution not named (YC page)
previous_startups: Three co-founded startups on access to financial markets, one with an exit, unnamed (YC page)
founders.background_notes: Former COO at financial markets companies per YC page

founders.name: Esteban Penaloza
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by Bloomberg Linea; handles finance and fundraising per another outlet

founders.name: Diego Torres
founders.background_notes: Named by Bloomberg Linea June 2025; operations and growth

founders.name: Luis Patt
founders.background_notes: Named by Bloomberg Linea November 2021 and Forbes 2022; absent from later sources

competitors.name: Traditional Colombian brokerages
competitors.what: Brokerages serving high-net-worth clients with fees of about 30 USD or more per trade

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile trading app integrated with exchange access through a licensed brokerage partner; regulatory compliance was the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Partnership with a licensed brokerage and local exchange integration, with later claims of a large share of local BVC transactions (single source).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bancolombia became an investor in 2022 rather than a competitor; Tyba later added stocks and ETFs per a 2024 article.

market_need_then: Few Colombians invested in the local exchange and costs were high; trii reported about 75,000 users and 13.5M USD assets within months of its March 2021 launch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned as a Colombian Robinhood democratizing investing

branding.brand_signature: The Robinhood of Colombia framing in press
branding.community_and_virality: Portafolio reported over 30,000 commission-free operations in a day; Forbes and Bloomberg Linea coverage

brand_strength.rationale: Regular national and regional press and reported 600K users by 2025 (single source), though no brand assets were documented.

outcome_analysis: trii launched in March 2021 as a Robinhood-style app on top of a licensed Colombian brokerage, raised a 4.5M seed at a reported 40M valuation in 2021, took 3M from Bancolombia in 2022 and new money from Crestone in 2025, reaching about 9M equity raised and reported break-even. It has grown to hundreds of thousands of users and is expanding to Peru, Chile and Mexico.
notes: Company website was not fetched. Bancolombia 3M date conflicts: Latamlist dated November 18, 2022 versus Bloomberg Linea June 2025 saying 2021 and one summary saying 2021 via Bancolombia Ventures; recorded as 2022-11 per the dated article. Seed amount: Bloomberg Linea says 4.5M equity plus 1M for lending at 40M valuation; Future Nexus says 5.5M seed led by Global Founders Capital. Total raised is 9M (Bloomberg Linea 2025), 10M (Future Nexus), 8.63M (CB Insights). Founded date varies: September 2019 (Forbes), 2020 (Latamlist), 2018 start (Forbes Chile). Founding city Bogota in 2021 and 2022 sources, Medellin in directory. Descubre.vc label Series A is unsupported. Name origin not found.
